selection_rule.hard_guardrail: false_abstention_rate must equal 0 on development; therefore no answerable development query may be rejected
objective_order: lexicographically smallest parameter tuple for deterministic tie break
selection_rule.validation: evaluate exactly once after development selection; no retuning
selection_rule.withheld: report once with selected parameters, descriptive auxiliary only; no retuning

confidence_features.absolute_score: exact frozen candidate-v2 top-1 retrieval score before timestamp/index tie-break
confidence_features.margin: top-1 score minus top-2 score, or top-1 score if only one memory exists
confidence_features.evidence_coverage: IDF-weighted coverage of non-stopword query content tokens by the top-1 memory, using the same query-IDF construction as candidate v2

claim_boundary: Auxiliary abstention-layer research. Does not modify candidate v2, complete Gate E, establish parity, or restore hidden status to previously observed withheld cases.
